gloss: last-minute rush; rushing in; emergency shelter

definitions.gloss: last-minute rush; rushing in at the last moment
definitions.explanation: doing something hastily just before a deadline, or rushing into a closing door/entrance
a place where people can take refuge in emergencies; also used for shelters for domestic abuse victims

examples.japanese: {駆|か}け{込|こ}み{乗車|じょうしゃ}は{危険|きけん}です。
{締|し}め{切|き}り{前|まえ}に{駆|か}け{込|こ}みで{申請|しんせい}した。
examples.english: I applied at the last minute before the deadline.

examples.japanese: {増税|ぞうぜい}{前|まえ}の{駆|か}け{込|こ}み{需要|じゅよう}で{売上|うりあげ}が{増|ふ}えた。
examples.english: Sales increased due to last-minute demand before the tax hike.

examples.japanese: {駆|か}け{込|こ}み{寺|てら}に{助|たす}けを{求|もと}める。
examples.english: To seek help at a refuge shelter.

examples.japanese: DVの{被害者|ひがいしゃ}を{駆|か}け{込|こ}みシェルターで{保護|ほご}する。
examples.english: To protect domestic violence victims at an emergency shelter.

examples.japanese: {交番|こうばん}は{地域|ちいき}の{駆|か}け{込|こ}み{場所|ばしょ}になっている。
examples.english: Police boxes serve as emergency refuge points in the community.

notes:
FORMATION:
{駆|か}ける (to run) + {込|こ}む (to rush into) → rushing in

SENSE 1 - LAST-MINUTE:
- {駆|か}け{込|こ}み{乗車|じょうしゃ} (rushing onto trains - dangerous and discouraged)
- {駆|か}け{込|こ}み{需要|じゅよう} (last-minute demand, e.g., before price increases)
- {駆|か}け{込|こ}み{申請|しんせい} (last-minute application)

SENSE 2 - REFUGE:
- {駆|か}け{込|こ}み{寺|てら} (temple refuge - historically for abused women)
- {駆|か}け{込|こ}みシェルター (emergency shelter)

TRAIN SAFETY:
Announcements on Japanese trains frequently warn against {駆|か}け{込|こ}み{乗車|じょうしゃ} (rushing onto trains before doors close).

VERB FORM:
- {駆|か}け{込|こ}む (to rush in)

RELATED:
- {滑|すべ}り{込|こ}み (slipping in at the last moment)
- {飛|と}び{込|こ}み (jumping in unexpectedly)
